title: DkimSigner type repeated 6+ times; needs type alias
description: Option<Arc<mail_auth::dkim::DkimSigner<mail_auth::common::crypto::Ed25519Key, mail_auth::dkim::Done>>> appears in struct fields and fn signatures across queue.rs, relay_queue.rs, main.rs at least 6 times. No type alias. If the signer type changes (e.g. algorithm upgrade), every site drifts independently. A type alias type DkimSignerArc = Arc<DkimSigner<Ed25519Key, Done>> in config.rs reduces all sites to Option<DkimSignerArc>.
